name: George Washington University
header:
George Washington University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Ranking entry: 93. 2026 secondary rank93; official admissions research is independent.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• General GRE is required; Math GRE is optional.
• The pending UChicago degree is explicitly covered by the English waiver.
• Faculty fit is primarily noncommutative algebra/algebraic combinatorics; do not infer a broad AG/NT group
from the Mathematics program name.
• Separate fellowship advertisements often exclude this applicant through institution, subject or citizenship
conditions.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor’s in mathematics or equivalent is sufficient; GPA3.0 is preferred, with holistic review below that level.
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s is an eligible route if completed before entry. F-1 applicants are permitted.
The department explicitly advertises fully funded Fall 2027 openings. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the GW graduate application; choose Mathematics PhD/Fall 2027 and answer yes to the funding question.
Start reference requests early using the Send to Recommender action. A pending UChicago degree can qualify
for the automatic English waiver. I-20/DS-2019 supporting documents are not required with the initial
academic application. [s5] [s6] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No advance supervisor agreement is listed. Algebra/representation-adjacent fits below are stronger than direct
algebraic or arithmetic geometry: the current research roster did not establish a dedicated
AG/complex-geometry/number-theory advising group. Confirm topic and availability before investing in an
application. [s1] [s18] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online GW application with separate Send to Recommender controls and postsubmission checklist. Official test
reports come directly from the agency; all ordinary nonreference materials are uploaded by the applicant.
Payment may take roughly an hour to clear. [s5] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 Mathematics PhD and January 15, 2027 are explicit in the live program directory; the department
explicitly advertises fundedFall 2027 places. Historical reports of a prior admission pause do not describe this
current announcement. [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 Mathematics PhD. CCAS complete applications are due11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
on the deadline. [s4] [s6]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Complete the degree application by January 15 for full assistantship consideration and select financial-aid

interest. No separate ordinary first-year funding application is required. The Fall 2027 program announcement
confirms openings. [s2] [s5] [s6]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
All required materials, including references, must be received by the complete-file deadline: January 15, 2027,
11:59 p.m. Eastern. Technical permission to submit before letters arrive is not a grace period. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Required official scores must be received for a complete file by January 15, 2027. Allow approximately two
weeks for agency delivery and processing; already received reports may take two business days to match. GRE
General is required even though English may be waived. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload required academic documents by the same January 15, 2027 complete-file cutoff. Final official
records/degree evidence follow admission; the exact individual post-offer due date was not established. [s4] [s6]
[s8]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
The offer supplies the response date; no universal Mathematics Fall 2027 date was established. A PhD deferral
of up to one year may be approved individually, not presumed. Current funding-response protections should be
verified separately. [s6]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Unless exempt: TOEFL100 old scale or5 new scale, IELTS7.0 with each>=6, DET130 or PTE68. Scores are valid
two years; official reports required, TOEFL code5246, no MyBest. Mathematics requirements are listed in the
doctoral-program directory. [s3] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Explicitly covers a US regionally accredited degree already earned OR to be completed before GW enrollment.
Your pending UChicago bachelor’s fits this route. Submit without scores; CCAS normally updates the exemption
within two business days. No separate waiver request is needed, although GW may request evidence/testing in
an individual case. [s8]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Required for Mathematics PhD. Do not apply a university-wide optional-test statement to this department. [s1]
[s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Encouraged but optional; applications without it receive full consideration. [s1]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Unofficial transcripts from all colleges attended, including transfer/nondegree work, normally suffice initially.
Records must show name, institution, program and chronological coursework; scans or institutional PDFs are
acceptable, self-created/edited records are not. Some study-abroad and high-school dual-enrollment
exceptions exist. Foreign-language records require translations; no blanket WES requirement. [s6] [s8]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
The department encourages mention of relevant courses absent from the transcript. It does not prescribe a
separate mathematics-course-list form or limit; include them in an allowed statement/CV field and verify the
portal. [s1]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course-description requirement, length or upload slot was located. Do not assume a syllabus
bundle is requested. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three. The department values evidence from recent advanced mathematics courses or research/REUs;
employment or elementary-calculus-only letters are less informative. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary doctoral merit funding uses the admission file without extra references. The separate Presidential
Fellowship requires two, but is restricted to current GW students and is not an option for a UChicago
undergraduate. [s6] [s12]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Enter name/email and click Send to Recommender; that action emails the invitation. Typing details alone is not
the documented send action. [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before submitting the application. Submission while letters are pending is allowed, but
the complete-file deadline still controls review. [s5] [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
The status checklist displays received/missing items with green checks/red Xs. Staff matching can take one to
two business days; follow up before the deadline if a referee reports submission but the item remains missing.
[s5] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
The portal permits reminders and changes/additions to referees. Interfolio or other credential-service packets
can be sent directly using the offline route; applicants may not upload confidential letters. Replacement of a
completed letter and automatic reuse across cycles are not publicly established. [s5] [s6]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Resume required. No public mathematics length/font/file limit was found; use the application upload
instructions. [s3] [s7]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required,250-500 words. Prompt paraphrase: purpose, academic/research interests and career plans, plus
qualifications not already represented elsewhere. Funding applicants should describe teaching experience. The
FAQ treats the range as guidance and suggests staying within about25%, but250-500 is the safe target.
Font/spacing/file rules remain portal-dependent. [s3] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list; Scholarship essays
[Unresolved]
No separate required document is listed for ordinary Mathematics PhD admission/funding. Optional upload/link
permission, exact prompt and limits are not established; inspect the live form rather than adding an unsolicited
attachment. [s3] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include in the SOP. No separate research-interest essay is listed apart from the required research-experience
supplement below. [s3]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required research-experience supplement begins: “Briefly describe your most relevant research experience”.
Paraphrase of remaining guidance: identify the setting/venue and mathematical content, such as thesis, REU,
talk or publication. No independent length or formatting rule is public. This does not establish that a full paper
upload is required or accepted. [s3]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Relevant untranscripted courses are encouraged information, not a published required standalone essay/form;
no public format or length. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
The research-experience supplement is a distinct department requirement; funding interest and teaching
experience must also be addressed as instructed. Any additional short-answer boxes/character limits are
visible only in the live form and were not verified. [s3] [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Fall 2027 fully funded positions are explicitly available, but no exact 2027 Mathematics stipend is public in the
pages checked. The university’s older 2024-25/2025-26 doctoral minimum is USD26,100 for two semesters
(13,050 per semester), not a 2027 offer. Department TA package combines fellowship/salary and tuition up to9
credits/semester; CCAS describes health-insurance subsidy. Fees and summer guarantees remain unverified.
[s2] [s9] [s10]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Normal departmental support is five years, with a sixth possible when justified; continuation depends on
academic progress and teaching performance. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students may receive departmental merit funding. Federal need-based assistance is limited by
citizenship/eligible-status rules; F-1 alone does not qualify. International TAs have a separate arrival-week
English interview and teaching presentation. [s2] [s6] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA duties average15 hours/week; continuing support requires satisfactory research/course progress and
teaching. The department requires a short teaching presentation and, for international students, an English
interview upon arrival. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select yes for financial aid in the academic application; no separate ordinary assistantship application.
Department-nomination fellowships use the admission record. Student-application fellowships are separate
and must be screened for eligibility. [s6] [s11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGSAF nomination awards include Provost/Selective Excellence and university fellowships; no extra student
action is normally required. The screened 2027 separate awards do not fit this applicant/program: Presidential
requires current GW study; Loughran is business/law; Walter Green is master’s-only; Wolcott restricts programs
and citizenship; DAR restricts subjects/citizenship; Scottish Rite requires US citizenship and verified affiliation.
They should not be counted as available math-PhD funding. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s15] [s16] [s17]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD80, nonrefundable. [s6] [s7]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
CCAS says no need-based waiver. Published categories include GW current/alumni, specified service/program
affiliations and qualifying recruitment-event attendance; UChicago enrollment alone is not a category. October

Virtual Open House attendees may receive an automatic waiver. The FAQ and requirements page name
different menu options; confirm before paying because refunds are not promised. [s6] [s7]

capacity.

text:
George Washington University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Ranking entry: 93. 2026 secondary rank93; official admissions research is independent.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• General GRE is required; Math GRE is optional.
• The pending UChicago degree is explicitly covered by the English waiver.
• Faculty fit is primarily noncommutative algebra/algebraic combinatorics; do not infer a broad AG/NT group
from the Mathematics program name.
• Separate fellowship advertisements often exclude this applicant through institution, subject or citizenship
conditions.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Bachelor’s in mathematics or equivalent is sufficient; GPA3.0 is preferred, with holistic review below that level.
A UChicago mathematics bachelor’s is an eligible route if completed before entry. F-1 applicants are permitted.
The department explicitly advertises fully funded Fall 2027 openings. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Use the GW graduate application; choose Mathematics PhD/Fall 2027 and answer yes to the funding question.
Start reference requests early using the Send to Recommender action. A pending UChicago degree can qualify
for the automatic English waiver. I-20/DS-2019 supporting documents are not required with the initial
academic application. [s5] [s6] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No advance supervisor agreement is listed. Algebra/representation-adjacent fits below are stronger than direct
algebraic or arithmetic geometry: the current research roster did not establish a dedicated
AG/complex-geometry/number-theory advising group. Confirm topic and availability before investing in an
application. [s1] [s18] [s19]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online GW application with separate Send to Recommender controls and postsubmission checklist. Official test
reports come directly from the agency; all ordinary nonreference materials are uploaded by the applicant.
Payment may take roughly an hour to clear. [s5] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 Mathematics PhD and January 15, 2027 are explicit in the live program directory; the department
explicitly advertises fundedFall 2027 places. Historical reports of a prior admission pause do not describe this
current announcement. [s2] [s4]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027 Mathematics PhD. CCAS complete applications are due11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
on the deadline. [s4] [s6]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Complete the degree application by January 15 for full assistantship consideration and select financial-aid

interest. No separate ordinary first-year funding application is required. The Fall 2027 program announcement
confirms openings. [s2] [s5] [s6]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
All required materials, including references, must be received by the complete-file deadline: January 15, 2027,
11:59 p.m. Eastern. Technical permission to submit before letters arrive is not a grace period. [s4] [s5] [s6]
Test-score receipt [2027 confirmed]
Required official scores must be received for a complete file by January 15, 2027. Allow approximately two
weeks for agency delivery and processing; already received reports may take two business days to match. GRE
General is required even though English may be waived. [s1] [s4] [s5] [s6]
Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
Upload required academic documents by the same January 15, 2027 complete-file cutoff. Final official
records/degree evidence follow admission; the exact individual post-offer due date was not established. [s4] [s6]
[s8]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
The offer supplies the response date; no universal Mathematics Fall 2027 date was established. A PhD deferral
of up to one year may be approved individually, not presumed. Current funding-response protections should be
verified separately. [s6]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Unless exempt: TOEFL100 old scale or5 new scale, IELTS7.0 with each>=6, DET130 or PTE68. Scores are valid
two years; official reports required, TOEFL code5246, no MyBest. Mathematics requirements are listed in the
doctoral-program directory. [s3] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Explicitly covers a US regionally accredited degree already earned OR to be completed before GW enrollment.
Your pending UChicago bachelor’s fits this route. Submit without scores; CCAS normally updates the exemption
within two business days. No separate waiver request is needed, although GW may request evidence/testing in
an individual case. [s8]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Required for Mathematics PhD. Do not apply a university-wide optional-test statement to this department. [s1]
[s3]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Encouraged but optional; applications without it receive full consideration. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Unofficial transcripts from all colleges attended, including transfer/nondegree work, normally suffice initially.
Records must show name, institution, program and chronological coursework; scans or institutional PDFs are
acceptable, self-created/edited records are not. Some study-abroad and high-school dual-enrollment
exceptions exist. Foreign-language records require translations; no blanket WES requirement. [s6] [s8]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
The department encourages mention of relevant courses absent from the transcript. It does not prescribe a
separate mathematics-course-list form or limit; include them in an allowed statement/CV field and verify the
portal. [s1]

Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course-description requirement, length or upload slot was located. Do not assume a syllabus
bundle is requested. [s1] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three. The department values evidence from recent advanced mathematics courses or research/REUs;
employment or elementary-calculus-only letters are less informative. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary doctoral merit funding uses the admission file without extra references. The separate Presidential
Fellowship requires two, but is restricted to current GW students and is not an option for a UChicago
undergraduate. [s6] [s12]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Enter name/email and click Send to Recommender; that action emails the invitation. Typing details alone is not
the documented send action. [s5]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before submitting the application. Submission while letters are pending is allowed, but
the complete-file deadline still controls review. [s5] [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
The status checklist displays received/missing items with green checks/red Xs. Staff matching can take one to
two business days; follow up before the deadline if a referee reports submission but the item remains missing.
[s5] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
The portal permits reminders and changes/additions to referees. Interfolio or other credential-service packets
can be sent directly using the offline route; applicants may not upload confidential letters. Replacement of a
completed letter and automatic reuse across cycles are not publicly established. [s5] [s6]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Resume required. No public mathematics length/font/file limit was found; use the application upload
instructions. [s3] [s7]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required,250-500 words. Prompt paraphrase: purpose, academic/research interests and career plans, plus
qualifications not already represented elsewhere. Funding applicants should describe teaching experience. The
FAQ treats the range as guidance and suggests staying within about25%, but250-500 is the safe target.
Font/spacing/file rules remain portal-dependent. [s3] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list; Scholarship essays
[Unresolved]
No separate required document is listed for ordinary Mathematics PhD admission/funding. Optional upload/link
permission, exact prompt and limits are not established; inspect the live form rather than adding an unsolicited
attachment. [s3] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include in the SOP. No separate research-interest essay is listed apart from the required research-experience
supplement below. [s3]

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required research-experience supplement begins: “Briefly describe your most relevant research experience”.
Paraphrase of remaining guidance: identify the setting/venue and mathematical content, such as thesis, REU,
talk or publication. No independent length or formatting rule is public. This does not establish that a full paper
upload is required or accepted. [s3]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Relevant untranscripted courses are encouraged information, not a published required standalone essay/form;
no public format or length. [s1]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
The research-experience supplement is a distinct department requirement; funding interest and teaching
experience must also be addressed as instructed. Any additional short-answer boxes/character limits are
visible only in the live form and were not verified. [s3] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
Fall 2027 fully funded positions are explicitly available, but no exact 2027 Mathematics stipend is public in the
pages checked. The university’s older 2024-25/2025-26 doctoral minimum is USD26,100 for two semesters
(13,050 per semester), not a 2027 offer. Department TA package combines fellowship/salary and tuition up to9
credits/semester; CCAS describes health-insurance subsidy. Fees and summer guarantees remain unverified.
[s2] [s9] [s10]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Normal departmental support is five years, with a sixth possible when justified; continuation depends on
academic progress and teaching performance. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students may receive departmental merit funding. Federal need-based assistance is limited by
citizenship/eligible-status rules; F-1 alone does not qualify. International TAs have a separate arrival-week
English interview and teaching presentation. [s2] [s6] [s8]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA duties average15 hours/week; continuing support requires satisfactory research/course progress and
teaching. The department requires a short teaching presentation and, for international students, an English
interview upon arrival. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select yes for financial aid in the academic application; no separate ordinary assistantship application.
Department-nomination fellowships use the admission record. Student-application fellowships are separate
and must be screened for eligibility. [s6] [s11]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
OGSAF nomination awards include Provost/Selective Excellence and university fellowships; no extra student
action is normally required. The screened 2027 separate awards do not fit this applicant/program: Presidential
requires current GW study; Loughran is business/law; Walter Green is master’s-only; Wolcott restricts programs
and citizenship; DAR restricts subjects/citizenship; Scottish Rite requires US citizenship and verified affiliation.
They should not be counted as available math-PhD funding. [s11] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s15] [s16] [s17]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD80, nonrefundable. [s6] [s7]
Fee waiver [Conflict]
CCAS says no need-based waiver. Published categories include GW current/alumni, specified service/program
affiliations and qualifying recruitment-event attendance; UChicago enrollment alone is not a category. October

Virtual Open House attendees may receive an automatic waiver. The FAQ and requirements page name
different menu options; confirm before paying because refunds are not promised. [s6] [s7]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Fee-waiver menu wording differs across current central pages. Won’s profile header/current homepage say
Associate Professor fromFall 2026 while a biography sentence still says Assistant. Funding minimums linked
publicly are 2025-26, not 2027-28. [s6] [s7] [s10] [s20] [s22]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Obtain the actual 2027 stipend, paid months, fees/insurance/summer package and offer-response date; inspect
live upload limits and research supplement box; confirm completed-letter update/reuse; verify current adviser
capacity.
